Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are already out in the middle now. Shevon Daniel and Lasith Croospulle are the two openers for Sri Lanka. Fareed Ahmad to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Sri Lanka, on the other hand, will be pleased with their bowling effort as the spinners and pacers complemented each other well, and their fielding and catching were top-notch as well. Nuwan Thushara set the tone for them by picking up a wicket on his very first ball. They controlled the middle phase and kept picking up wickets at regular intervals. Sahan Arachchige got a couple of wickets while Lahiru Samarakoon and Vijayakanth Viyaskanth chipped in with one each. However, the star of the show was Nuwan Thushara whose yorkers were almost unplayable and Afghanistan found that out the hard way as he ended up with an excellent four-wicket haul. Now, it is up to their batters to gun this total down and make it to the semi-final. Join us in a bit to see how the chase unfolds.

Afghanistan got off to a slow start and lost Sediqullah Atal quite early too. Mohammad Shahzad and Noor Ali Zadran steadied the ship for them, and they started to change gears after the drinks break. The former could not convert his start, while Shahidullah Kamal also played a good cameo in the middle. However, it was the gritty half-century from Noor Ali Zadran that got them somewhat back in the game. He was looking really good but just when he was about to cause more damage, he got run out which changed the whole complexion of the game as they went from 101/4 to 116 all out in a flash which has put them way behind in this game.

A brilliant bowling performance from Sri Lanka! They have restricted Afghanistan to just 116 runs and were in control for most parts of this innings. The Afghans will be disappointed as they would have hoped for a better show from their batters, but it is the Lankans who will be the happier side going into the break.

OUT! LBW! That is the end of the Afghanistan innings. Sahan Arachchige takes the round the wicket angle and bowls the ball full and at the stumps. Zahir Khan looks to flick int on the on side but misses out the ball completely. The ball hits him on the front leg in front of the stumps and the umpire raises the finger. Thats the end of the Afghanistan batting innings.

Commentary.Commentary: The umpires and the players make their way to the middle. It's Sri Lanka to bowl first. The players are out on the ground as well. Play is about to start very soon. We are moments away from the start of the game bur before that, both the teams have lined up for the National anthems. It's Afghanistan's National anthem first, followed by Sri Lanka.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Sahan Arachchige (C), Lasith Croospulle, Nuwanidu Fernando, Shevon Daniel, Ravindu Fernando, Lahiru Udara (WK), Ashen Bandara, Nimesh Vimukthi, Lahiru Samarakoon, Nuwan Thushara, Vijayakanth Viyaskanth.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Shahzad (WK), Sharafuddin Ashraf, Noor Ali Zadran, Sediqullah Atal, Gulbadin Naib (C), Afsar Zazai, Karim Janat, Shahidullah Kamal, Fareed Ahmad, Zahir Khan, Qais Ahmad.
TOSS UPDATE - Sri Lanka have won the toss and elected to bowl first.

Afghanistan, on the other hand, looks like a team that has come into the competition with a purpose. Mohammad Shahzad who is arguably their best T20 batter will hope to make his mark while others like Gulbadin Naib, Qais Ahmad, and Karim Janat make a strong core of their team. They have enough quality on their side, and they will also look to take extra motivation from their World Cup squad and get the better of the Lankans here too. Let's see who makes it to the semi-finals. Toss and team news in a bit.

Sri Lanka has sent quite a few youngsters to give them exposure and make them used to playing under pressure situations. The likes of Sahan Arachchige, Nuwanidu Fernando, Ashen Bandara, and Vijayakanth Viyaskanth will be the key players for them while they will hope that others also grab this chance and make a name for themselves. Coincidentally, less than 24 hours ago, these two sides met in a warm-up match before the start of the 2023 ODI World Cup where the Lankans lost which should add fire in the belly of this team as they seek revenge for that in this game.

Hello and welcome to our coverage of the 3rd Quarter-final in the Asian Games 2023 between two medal contenders Sri Lanka and Afghanistan. Both teams qualified directly to this stage due to their higher seeding and will hope to take this opportunity and progress to the next stage keeping their medal hopes alive.
